proof_body:
by
  intro A _ f
  have h1 : (∃ g : Polynomial A, g ≠ 0 ∧ f * g = 0) ↔ f ∉ nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial A) := by
    rw [notMem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, hg, h⟩
      exact ⟨g, by rw [mul_comm]; exact h, hg⟩
    · rintro ⟨g, h, hg⟩
      exact ⟨g, hg, by rw [mul_comm]; exact h⟩
  rw [h1, Polynomial.notMem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
  simp [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (f : Polynomial A), (∃ g : Polynomial A, g ≠ 0 ∧ f * g = 0) ↔ ∃ c : A, c ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.C c * f = 0
